description: Ministry of Science, Technology and Research    -   Fees Regulations of National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Intellectual Property Act, specifically the amendment of fees regulations for the National Intellectual Property Office. It contains statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks (fee structures for industrial designs and marks), which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name (Sujeewa Senasinghe), it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify for Types 1-3.
